newsitem.title: USA: Dana sees $0.67/shr gain from unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Dana sees $0.67/shr gain from unit sale.

text.p: Dana Corp said Wednesday it sees an after-tax gain of about $70 million or $0.67 per share, to be recognized upon closing, from the sale of its worldwide vehicular clutch business to Eaton Corp.

Under the terms of the agreement, announced earlier today by Eaton, Dana will sell its Spicer Clutch operations, which manufacture new and rebuilt medium/heavy-duty clutches for original equipment manufacturers, for $180 million in cash to Eaton.
Sales at the facilities to be sold are estimated at $179 million for 1997, the company said.
Under a marketing agreement with Eaton, Dana said it will continue to market and supply independent distribution customers with new and remanufactured clutches on a non-exclusive basis.
